name: Deepstaria
name_ja: ディープスタリアクラゲ
notes: Giant ulmarid jelly: a huge, extremely thin, sheet-like bell (about 60-70 cm) that billows like a plastic bag and closes around prey to bag it; the whole bell is covered by a fine anastomosing canal network like wire netting; no marginal tentacles, only short oral arms under a small stomach. Translucent, faintly violet-bronze. Moves by slow peristaltic waves (about 1.5 cm/s). Not bioluminescent.
